An employee reported clicking a phishing link and now their workstation shows unusual network activity—we need to investigate potential malware infection, contain the threat, and notify relevant teams. Please handle the analysis, containment, and alerting process immediately.
To proceed with the malware analysis, please provide the phishing URL that was clicked and any available file hashes from the affected workstation, including the hash type (e.g., SHA-256, MD5).
The phishing URL is http://malicious.example.com/phish. We also have a file hash from the workstation: d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e with hash type MD5.

source_summary.content: Analysis confirms malware infection via the provided phishing URL and file hash. To proceed with containment, please provide the affected endpoint's details including endpoint ID, hostname, and IP address, along with the user account details such as user ID and username. Also include the incident ID for tracking purposes and your requester ID.

The endpoint details are: endpointId EP-123, hostname workstation-emp123, IP address 192.168.1.100. User account involved is userId usr-456 with username employee@example.com, incident ID is INC-789, and my requester ID is sec-analyst-001.

To contain the threat, I will isolate endpoint 'workstation-emp123' with full isolation and disable account 'employee@example.com' across all systems. Please provide supervisor approval code, HR approval code, and confirmation codes for authorization.

Here are the required approval and confirmation codes: supervisor approval SUP-CODE-123, HR approval HR-CODE-456, isolation confirmation CONFIRM-ISO-789, and disable account confirmation CONFIRM-DIS-012.
